countries.reasoning: China is the largest hydrogen producer globally with extensive industrial hydrogen production primarily from coal reforming and electrolysis; data based on recent industry reports and national statistics of 2022-2023.
US is the second largest hydrogen producer mainly via natural gas reforming; production figures compiled from US Energy Information Administration and industry data for 2023.
Russia has significant hydrogen production from natural gas and coal; data from Russian national energy reports and global energy reviews 2022.
India is a large producer of hydrogen particularly for refining and chemicals; estimates derived from national energy and industrial output data with reasonable accuracy.
Japan produces hydrogen mainly for industrial use and is advancing electrolytic hydrogen; data from Japanese Ministry of Economy, Trade and Industry 2023 reports.
